## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.15
**Fixed** - **License stays active** — the app now revalidates your license automatically in the background. Previously a licensed Mac could silently fall back to "Trial" about a week after activation unless you reopened the License window. - **Menu layout** — the menu is more compact (same width in every language), the trailing buttons line up exactly with the submenu arrows, and the layout is correct from the very first click after launch.
